F1_posterior.source: v0.6 m13 holdout contrasts (SE 0.04-0.08 objective units); upper value used

F10_execution_realism.source: assumed 2x the generic SE (8 components instead of 9 families)

F11_noninferiority.note: delta = 0.10 x G0 selection objective (about 0.25) exceeds this resolution

F2_distinguishability.caveat: near the AUC ceiling (v0.6 AUC ~1) the attainable effect is bounded; H2 then reports VACUOUS

F8_robust_pairs.source: v0.6 m10 market-seed SD 5.3-8.6 bps; between-world SD from v0.6 sensitivity (1-4.8 bps, lower end assumed)
F8_robust_pairs.caveat: with between-world SD of 4.8 bps the MDE rises to 4.17 bps

F7_model_uncertainty.note: R > 1 is detectable when the between-world SD exceeds about 0.72 bps (approximate: SE of R ~0.15 with 21 worlds)

F12_transfer.source: v0.6 m14 transfer (ETH 2020-10-01, retrospective in v0.7) H11 intervals

rule: MDE = (z_{1-alpha/2} + z_{power}) * SE; inputs are sealed v0.6 pilot estimates
interpretation: Effects below the MDE are unlikely to be resolved; NOT_ESTABLISHED below the MDE is not evidence of absence.
